assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks unite ingenious control of atoms with an extraordinary advance in time and frequency measurement, opening durable new tests and applications.
assessment.attribution: Katori's lattice-clock concept and Ye's decisive experimental development form a clear, compact attribution.
assessment.maturity: The performance and scientific uses have been independently established over many years.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Trapped ions made controllable quantum systems into a powerful platform for computation, simulation, and precision quantum experiments.
assessment.attribution: Cirac and Zoller supplied foundational protocols, while Blatt represents the experimental realization; the three-person account is persuasive.
assessment.maturity: The platform has repeatedly demonstrated high-fidelity control and has seeded a broad international field.
uncertainties: The contribution overlaps conceptually with broader quantum-information and simulation candidates.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Geometric and topological phases changed how quantum mechanics is understood and supplied concepts now visible across modern physics.
assessment.attribution: Aharonov and Berry are strongly associated with the two foundational effects named, though their historical and conceptual settings differ.
assessment.maturity: Both effects have long been experimentally explored and have generated extensive physical consequences.
uncertainties: Whether the two effects make one sufficiently unified prize is a judgment question.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Strongly interacting Fermi gases gave unusually clean access to fermionic pairing and universal many-body physics.
assessment.attribution: These laboratories made central complementary experimental contributions to the crossover and strongly interacting regime.
assessment.maturity: The results have been reproduced broadly and remain a mature reference system for quantum many-body physics.
uncertainties: Several additional laboratories contributed importantly to the wider field.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Conductance quantization revealed quantum transport with remarkable directness and became a cornerstone of mesoscopic physics.
assessment.attribution: The listed experimental pioneers offer a credible account of the discovery and its early establishment.
assessment.maturity: The effect is exceptionally well confirmed and foundational to subsequent nanoscale transport research.
uncertainties: Priority and the relative roles of parallel early experiments require careful historical scrutiny.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Atom interferometry has turned matter-wave coherence into a precise tool for fundamental tests and sensing.
assessment.attribution: Bordé and Pritchard supplied foundational ideas and methods, while Kasevich represents landmark experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: Its precision, breadth, and continuing experimental development are well established.
uncertainties: The field's distributed development makes a three-person attribution difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Practical femtosecond lasers transformed the ability to resolve and control ultrafast physical processes.
assessment.attribution: Moulton's titanium-sapphire laser and Keller's and Sibbett's mode-locking advances provide a coherent technological and scientific chain.
assessment.maturity: The methods have been indispensable for decades, including the development of attosecond science.
uncertainties: The credit boundary between laser media, mode-locking mechanisms, and wider ultrafast-laser development needs close examination.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inflation and the quantum origin of structure provide an exceptionally influential framework for early-universe physics.
assessment.attribution: Guth, Linde, and Mukhanov represent major distinct conceptual contributions to the inflationary account.
assessment.maturity: Its predictions have shaped cosmological observation, although the underlying inflationary mechanism remains unsettled.
uncertainties: No unique inflation model has been directly confirmed.
Attribution among the many theorists who developed inflation is intrinsically difficult.
